info.name: Companies AI Embed Tenant Rate Limits API

params.name: orgId
params.description: Target organization ID (must belong to the tenant).

items.docs: Sets a BLOCKED override for the specified child organization. Caller must be the tenant owner organization with org settings write access.

info.name: Get organization rate limit override status

params.name: orgId
params.description: Target organization ID (must belong to the tenant).

items.docs: Returns effective rate limit mode and whether an explicit override exists for the organization.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Target organization ID (must belong to the tenant).

items.docs: Removes any explicit BLOCKED or UNLIMITED override so the tenant default applies.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Target organization ID (must belong to the tenant).

items.docs: Sets an UNLIMITED override for the specified child organization. Caller must be the tenant owner organization with org settings write access.

info.name: Get tenant default rate limit mode

items.docs: Returns the default rate limit mode applied to child organizations when no per-org override exists. Only the tenant owner organization may call this.

info.name: Set tenant default rate limit mode

items.docs: Updates the default rate limit mode for child organizations. Only the tenant owner organization may call this.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response pagination.nextCursor.

items.docs: Paginated list of organizations with an explicit BLOCKED or UNLIMITED override. Only the tenant owner organization may call this.
